name: Fall Armyworm Larva
symptoms: Caterpillars feeding inside maize whorl Large chewing damage on leaves Presence of dark frass near feeding areas Leaves shredded or skeletonized
description: The larva (caterpillar) is the damaging stage of the fall armyworm. It feeds aggressively on crop leaves and can destroy plants quickly.
management: Scout fields regularly for larvae Crush egg masses and young larvae Apply biological or chemical control early
prevention: Early detection in maize whorl Use resistant crop varieties Crop rotation
